title: Hair Crimping: Heat Damage & What the Research Shows
seo_title: Hair Crimping: Heat Damage, Safety & What Research Shows | FullyVital
seo_description: What hair crimping is, why there's no evidence it helps hair growth, what lab studies show about heat-styling damage, and how to reduce it.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.

Old post (2,258 words, 0 study links) claimed crimping was 'a stylish solution for healthy hair growth'. No evidence supports that, so the framing was removed. Rewritten around heat-styling damage research.
Topic is styling: no supplement push; widgets kept; the plain in-post image is preserved by the extended builder.
flags: Heat-damage studies used flat irons, not crimpers; the article says so.
'Style dry hair / lowest effective heat / give your hair breaks' mix sourced findings (wet hair, heat protection) with general advice (low heat, breaks).
Styling advice is not medical advice.
